subject: gk
question: How many Fundamental rights are provided by Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer __6 (Six)__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel is considered the father of Fundamental rights in India.
 
• Fundamental rights are justifiable.
 
• In the original constitution, there were seven categories of fundamental rights in India.
 
• After the deletion of the Right to property by the 44th Amendment, it was reduced to six.
 
• The right to property is a legal right now.
 
• The Supreme court and the High Courts are considered as the guardians of Fundamental rights in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Now there are six categories of fundamental rights in India.

 
 
• Right to Equality.
 
• Right to Freedom.
 
• Right against Exploitation.
 
• Right to Freedom of Religion.
 
• Cultural and Educational Rights.
 
• Right to Constitutional Remedies.
